knowledge:
- key_parameters: segMedianT=threshold parameter for segmentation (e.g., segMedianT=0.2) ;; plot.type=type of plot in segPlot (e.g., "w" for whole genome, "s" for single chromosome/sample-wise)
- alternatives: DNAcopy (Olshen et al., 2004) which implements Circular Binary Segmentation (CBS). fastseg is considerably faster and more flexible, making it preferable for large datasets (like NGS or high-density microarrays).
- when_to_use: Appropriate for detecting copy number segments from DNA microarrays or NGS data, identifying transcripts from RNA tiling microarrays, or general segmentation of numeric vectors and matrices.
- pitfalls: Segmentation quality depends strongly on parameter settings (e.g., segMedianT). Missing values (NA) in the input data may need to be imputed (e.g., using the median) prior to running fastseg.

workflows.name: genomic_ranges_segmentation
workflows.intent: Segment genomic data represented as a GRanges object to identify copy number segments and plot the results.
input: gr (GRanges object containing genomic coordinates and sample intensity/log-ratio data in metadata columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Load GenomicRanges and fastseg packages ;; 2. Run segmentation using fastseg ;; 3. Plot the segmentation results using segPlot
workflows.code:
library(fastseg)
library("GenomicRanges")

## with both individuals
gr <- GRanges(seqnames=chrom,
        ranges=IRanges(maploc, end=maploc))
mcols(gr) <- data
colnames(mcols(gr)) <- samplenames
res <- fastseg(gr)
head(res)

## with one individual
gr2 <- gr
data2 <- as.matrix(data[, 1])
colnames(data2) <- "sample1"
mcols(gr2) <- data2
res <- fastseg(gr2)
head(res)

## with both individuals
gr <- GRanges(seqnames=chrom,
        ranges=IRanges(maploc, end=maploc))
mcols(gr) <- data
colnames(mcols(gr)) <- samplenames
res <- fastseg(gr,segMedianT=0.2)

segPlot(gr,res, plot.type="w")
segPlot(gr, res, plot.type="s")

workflows.name: expressionset_segmentation
workflows.intent: Segment microarray expression data represented as an ExpressionSet object.
input: eSet (ExpressionSet object containing intensity data and feature annotations for chromosomes and positions)
workflows.stages: 1. Load Biobase and fastseg packages ;; 2. Construct or load the ExpressionSet object ;; 3. Run segmentation using fastseg
workflows.code:
library(fastseg)
library("Biobase")
eSet <- Biobase::ExpressionSet()
assayData(eSet) <- list(intensity=data)

featureData(eSet) <- AnnotatedDataFrame(
        data=data.frame(
                chrom = paste("chr",chrom,sep=""),
                start = maploc, 
                end   = maploc,stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
phenoData(eSet) <- AnnotatedDataFrame(
        data=data.frame(samples=samplenames))
sampleNames(eSet) <- samplenames
res <- fastseg(eSet)
head(res)

workflows.name: vector_matrix_segmentation
workflows.intent: Segment raw numeric vectors or matrices without genomic coordinate metadata.
input: data2 (numeric vector or matrix of intensity values)
workflows.stages: 1. Load fastseg package ;; 2. Run segmentation on a vector or matrix using fastseg
workflows.code:
library(fastseg)
data2 <- data[, 1]
res <- fastseg(data2)
head(res)

data2 <- data[1:400, ]
res <- fastseg(data2)
head(res)
